description.value:
Requirement Your Oath is the Cinder Vow.

Duration constant

The Choir's ash carries your Answer farther than your arm does.

When you Answer, the interloper need only be within 30 feet of you rather than within your reach. If it is out of reach, you make the Answer's Strike as a ranged Strike with a range of 30 feet using the melee weapon you wield — the ash carries the blow; the weapon isn't thrown and stays in your hand. If the interloper is within reach you Strike it as normal.

cinderfall.incomplete: No rule element converts a melee weapon's Strike into a ranged Strike at a stated range while the weapon stays in hand and is not thrown -- distinct from the real "thrown" weapon trait (which requires the weapon to actually leave the wielder's hand). No selector or rule-element key anywhere in pf2e-source models this.
